note: The crystal cave arena on the BARE plate (1536x1024) — RaidPrep, RaidView and
Results for the cave encounters.
NO ambient actors here, on purpose. spec 09 §4.3 row 5 gives the twelve
combatants to the raid screen, placed from the party that actually departed;
a scene that shipped its own crowd would put strangers in the fight. What the
scene owns is the room: the miners' lanterns, the crystal light, and the motes.
Two light temperatures, and they are not interchangeable. The lantern chain down
the left and along the right gallery is #FFB060 at low energy; the crystals are
#78C8FF and get no flame sprite, because a crystal does not burn — it pulses,
which is what a breathing PointLight2D already does.
Checked with `python tools/art/preview_scene.py stage_arena_cave --view raidview --marks`.
`marks` (W1-STAGE, STAGE-01/06/21) is the fight's blocking, in plate pixels: `view` is the
offset RaidView/Results apply (plate rows 280..1015 are on screen), `party.ranks` are feet
points on the lower-left lantern floor (tanks nearest the bridge, facing right), `boss.pos`
is the feet point on the lower-right railed ledge, `boss.floor` the stone it may stand on,
flipped to face the party. `party.scale` 2 is figure_scale; `boss.scale` is 2 (BL-103, Q02's
'upscale ok'). The big cold crystal above the plateau (900,230) was authored under
the boss plate's chrome, so its light, motes and pulse moved to the pool spire under the
bridge (STAGE-21) — in the band, between the two sides.
W7-STAGE (2026-09-15; UI-21, UI-22, BL-103): the party stands across the plateau's width — the
front rank at an 84px pitch, the ranks staggered by half a pitch and 44px apart, so every head
shows between the two in front of it and no two body rects overlap by more than a quarter
(test_scene_stage measures the widest class strip, the wizard's 78x90, in every slot); the
back rank's feet (y 604) stand on the plateau floor behind the lantern post. The boss is 2x now,
like the party (Q02 ruled 'upscale ok' — one pixel pitch on the floor), and stands IN FRONT of
the ledge's fence, at the bridge's far landing: feet (1030, 790) on the lip below the near rail,
which puts a 2x Main Boss (310x262) at x 875..1185 — clear of the front rank's rightmost figure
(x 660 + 39) by 176px, and a 400px footprint (boss_main_2) by 131 and of the ledge lantern's
flame sprite (1236..1252) by 6. `boss.floor` is that lip, 150x40, and RaidView.boss_feet_y keeps
every creature's feet on it.
spec 09 §5 rows 4 and 5, both in one room: the pools shimmer, and the crystal clusters
pulse ±10% on a 3-second period — the row's own numbers. The crystals get a quad rather
than another PointLight2D because §5 row 5 asks for a value pulse on a masked quad, and
because three more lights on the screen that already carries the most work is a cost
with no picture behind it.
